_comment: Default Stapel theme (§68 — neutral colour-role dictionary; frontend-guardrails §1). SOURCE OF TRUTH — code (tokens.css/tokens.ts/tailwind*.css) is generated from this file via `stapel-tokens` (pnpm gen:tokens) and drift-gated by `pnpm gen:tokens:check`. A host copies this to `stapel.theme.json` and edits it; absence of a host file = this default. TWO LEVELS: (L1) `ramps` = custom raw ramps merged over the built-in standard ramps (ramps.standard.json) — hex is born here and NOWHERE else; (L2) `core` = neutral semantic ROLES (§68 dictionary — surface/text/border/brand/link families + success/warning/error/info types), each EXACTLY a {light,dark} pair of `<ramp>.<step>` refs (unpaired or hex ⇒ build error). There is no component (L3) tier — a role IS the CSS var (`--stapel-<role>`); design-system bridges (tokens-antd, tokens-mui) translate roles straight into their own theme fields. `scales`/`elevation` are the non-colour tokens on the same source.

_contrastExceptionsComment: Documented per-pairing escape hatch for the contrast GATE (src/gen/contrast.mjs CONTRAST_PAIRS, checked by validateTheme in src/gen/lib.mjs). The gate is a cross product since 2026-09-14 (text family x every fill, chrome x every surface, both modes); every text pair passes in both modes, and the entries here are the two DECORATIVE chrome roles in light (border 2.0:1, border-subtle 1.4:1 on white), pinned to the reference's light outlines by owner decision; each reason names what carries the boundary instead, and the stale-exception check deletes an entry the moment its pair passes. Format: { "fg": "<role>", "bg": "<role>", "mode": "light"|"dark", "reason": "<why this pairing is intentionally exempt>" }. `reason` is required (non-empty) — an exception can never be silent. An entry that stops failing (pairing now legit) or that is malformed is itself a validation ERROR — the list must only ever hold live, reasoned exceptions.

scales._controlsComment: Control SHAPE axis (owner escalation 2026-09-02): the height every design-system bridge hands its controls. `height` = the wide seed (antd's own 32); `height-phone` = the fleet's phone touch floor (WCAG 2.5.8 / platform HIGs: 44). Emitted as --stapel-control-height / --stapel-control-height-phone; bridges read them LIVE off the document like every colour role, so a host overrides control height by editing this scale and regenerating. Control radius/font-size need no axis of their own — the bridges read the existing --stapel-radius-md / --stapel-font-size-md live (one dictionary, no twins).
scales._responsiveComment: A scale role whose value changes with the VIEWPORT, authored as SPACING STEP names so it stays on the scale a theme retunes in one place. Emitted mobile-first: the narrowest breakpoint is the base declaration and every wider one is an @media arm. `page-gutter` is how far a page's content sits from the edge of the window — one number cannot serve both a 390px phone (where 24px is a tenth of the screen) and a 1440px desktop, and each component guessing for itself is what put three different left edges down one composed page.
